fullPassage:
Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be demanding. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with guidance and the sense of purpose they need to succeed. We asked our teenage readers about their role models and the qualities they admire most in them. After you read each student's story, you will get a better idea of the profound impact role models can have when it comes to shaping career goals.

My role model is Jacques Cousteau, a famous ocean explorer. As a young boy, Cousteau was involved in a serious car accident, and doctors told him he might never use his arms again. However, he refused to give up. Following his doctors' advice, he started swimming as a way to strengthen his arms. It was during this recovery that he became intrigued by the underwater world. At the time, diving equipment was insufficient for deep exploration. This challenge inspired Cousteau to co-invent the Aqua-Lung, a device that allowed divers to breathe underwater for extended periods. He also produced a famous documentary that opened people's eyes to the beauty and fragility of ocean life. Cousteau became a leading figure in marine conservation. What I admire most about him is his curiosity and passion for pushing beyond boundaries.

My role model is Joan Beauchamp Procter, a pioneering British zoologist who devoted her life to the study of reptiles. From a young age, Procter showed a deep devotion to animals, especially reptiles. She was so immersed in her studies that she often brought her pet reptiles to school. Despite suffering from serious health problems throughout her life, she never let them hold her back. Procter gained extensive knowledge of reptiles, and at the age of just sixteen, she began exchanging letters with George Albert Boulenger, one of the most respected zoologists of that era. Impressed by her knowledge, Boulenger encouraged her to pursue a career in zoology. She went on to become the curator of the Reptile House at the London Zoo, where she transformed it into a world-class facility by incorporating technology and innovative design.

My role model is Kim Sang-jin, a Korean animator who worked at Disney. From a young age, Kim was enthusiastic about drawing and dreamed of becoming an animator. However, he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency, which disrupted his plans. Many people tried to discourage him from pursuing art, but he refused to give up. Instead, he earned an economics degree while continuing to develop his drawing skills. He built an impressive portfolio and eventually landed a position at Walt Disney Studios. What I admire most about Kim is his persistence and positive attitude. He never let obstacles define his future.

These stories show us the importance of having role models. Whether it is Cousteau's curiosity, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence, each of them demonstrates qualities that can inspire us. Their commitment and optimism teach us that career exploration is a journey, not a destination. Role models remind us that with hard work and dedication, we can achieve our goals.

questions.passage: Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be (A)[demanding / effortless]. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with (B)[guidance / confusion] and the sense of purpose they need to succeed. We asked our teenage readers about their role models and the qualities they admire most in them. After you read each student's story, you will get a better idea of the (C)[profound / trivial] impact role models can have when it comes to shaping career goals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 진로를 정하는 것은 힘들 수(demanding) 있고, 롤모델은 지침(guidance)을 제공하며, 깊은(profound) 영향을 미친다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① demanding — guidance — profound: 원문 일치
❌ ② effortless(수월한): demanding의 반의어
❌ ③ confusion(혼란): guidance의 반의어
❌ ④ trivial(사소한): profound의 반의어
det.tip: demanding(힘든) ↔ effortless(수월한), guidance(지침) ↔ confusion(혼란), profound(깊은) ↔ trivial(사소한)

questions.passage: My role model is Jacques Cousteau, a famous ocean explorer. As a young boy, Cousteau was involved in a serious car accident, and doctors told him he might never use his arms again. However, he refused to give up. Following his doctors' advice, he started swimming as a way to strengthen his arms. It was during this recovery that he became (A)[intrigued / bored] by the underwater world. At the time, diving equipment was (B)[insufficient / adequate] for deep exploration. This challenge inspired Cousteau to co-invent the Aqua-Lung, a device that allowed divers to breathe underwater for (C)[extended / limited] periods. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 수중 세계에 흥미를 느끼게(intrigued) 되었고, 장비가 불충분(insufficient)했으며, 장시간(extended) 호흡할 수 있는 장치를 공동 발명했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ intrigued — insufficient — extended: 원문 일치
❌ ① bored(지루한): intrigued의 반의어
❌ ② adequate(충분한): insufficient의 반의어
❌ ④ limited(제한된): extended의 반의어
det.tip: intrigued(흥미를 느낀) ↔ bored(지루한), insufficient(불충분한) ↔ adequate(충분한), extended(연장된) ↔ limited(제한된)

questions.passage: My role model is Joan Beauchamp Procter, a pioneering British zoologist who devoted her life to the study of reptiles. From a young age, Procter showed a deep (A)[devotion / indifference] to animals, especially reptiles. She was so immersed in her studies that she often brought her pet reptiles to school. Despite suffering from serious health problems throughout her life, she never let them hold her back. Procter gained (B)[extensive / limited] knowledge of reptiles, and at the age of just sixteen, she began exchanging letters with George Albert Boulenger, one of the most (C)[respected / disregarded] zoologists of that era. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 동물에 대한 깊은 헌신(devotion), 광범위한(extensive) 지식, 가장 존경받는(respected) 동물학자.
det.analysis:
✅ ② devotion — extensive — respected: 원문 일치
❌ ① indifference(무관심): devotion의 반의어
❌ ③ limited(제한된): extensive의 반의어
❌ ④ disregarded(무시당하는): respected의 반의어
det.tip: devotion(헌신) ↔ indifference(무관심), extensive(광범위한) ↔ limited(제한된), respected(존경받는) ↔ disregarded(무시당하는)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ 원문은 '깊은(profound)' 영향인데, '사소한(trivial)'으로 바뀌었다. 롤모델의 영향은 사소한 것이 아니라 깊고 큰 것이다.

✅ ② admire: 존경하다, 원문 일치

det.korean: 파충류에 대한 광범위한(extensive) 지식을 쌓았다.

ch: He is a key figure in the company.

det.korean: 디즈니 스튜디오에 자리를 얻었다(landed a position).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ landed her dream job = 일자리를 얻다: 본문과 같은 의미
❌ ① landed at the airport = 착륙하다
❌ ② landed on the flower = (가볍게) 내려앉다
❌ ④ landed in the yard = 떨어지다
det.tip: land의 다의어: ① 착륙하다 ② 내려앉다 ③ (일자리/기회를) 얻다 ④ 떨어지다. 본문에서는 ③의 의미.

questions.passage: My role model is Joan Beauchamp Procter, a pioneering British zoologist who devoted her life to the study of reptiles. From a young age, Procter showed a deep devotion to animals, especially reptiles. She was so immersed in her studies that she often brought her pet reptiles to school. Despite suffering from serious health problems throughout her life, she never let them hold her back. Procter gained extensive knowledge of reptiles, and at the age of just sixteen, she began exchanging letters with George Albert Boulenger, one of the most respected zoologists of that era. Impressed by her knowledge, Boulenger encouraged her to pursue a career in zoology. She went on to become the curator of the Reptile House at the London Zoo, where she transformed it into a world-class facility by __________ technology and innovative design. [incorporate]
questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 주어진 단어의 알맞은 형태를 **영어**로 쓰시오.

She transformed it into a world-class facility by __________ technology and innovative design. [incorporate]

det.korean: 기술과 혁신적 설계를 도입하여(incorporating) 세계적 수준의 시설로 탈바꿈시켰다.
det.analysis: ✅ incorporating: incorporate(통합하다/도입하다)의 동명사. 전치사 by 뒤이므로 동명사 형태.
det.tip: incorporate → incorporating: 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 온다. by + 동명사: ~함으로써.

questions.passage: My role model is Jacques Cousteau, a famous ocean explorer. As a young boy, Cousteau was involved in a serious car accident, and doctors told him he might never use his arms again. However, he refused to give up. Following his doctors' advice, he started swimming as a way to strengthen his arms. It was during this recovery that he became intrigued by the underwater world. At the time, diving equipment was insufficient for deep exploration. This challenge inspired Cousteau to co-invent the Aqua-Lung, a device that allowed divers to breathe underwater for extended periods. He also produced a famous documentary that opened people's eyes to the beauty and __________ of ocean life.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 적절한 단어를 원문에서 **영어**로 찾아 쓰시오.

조건: '취약함, 연약함'이라는 뜻의 명사 1개

det.korean: 해양 생태계의 아름다움과 취약함(fragility)을 사람들에게 알렸다.
det.analysis: ✅ fragility: 취약함, 연약함. beauty and fragility가 병렬 구조.
det.tip: fragile(형용사, 깨지기 쉬운) → fragility(명사, 취약함). beauty and fragility: and로 연결된 병렬 명사.

questions.passage: These stories show us the importance of having role models. Whether it is Cousteau's __________, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence, each of them demonstrates qualities that can inspire us. Their commitment and optimism teach us that career exploration is a journey, not a destination. Role models remind us that with hard work and dedication, we can achieve our goals.
questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 주어진 단어의 알맞은 형태를 **영어**로 쓰시오.

Whether it is Cousteau's __________, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence [curious]

det.korean: 쿠스토의 호기심(curiosity), Procter의 헌신, Kim의 끈기 중 어느 것이든.
det.analysis: ✅ curiosity: curious(형용사, 호기심이 많은)의 명사형. 소유격(Cousteau's) 뒤에 명사가 필요.
det.tip: curious(형용사) → curiosity(명사): 소유격 뒤에 명사가 필요. Cousteau's curiosity, Procter's devotion, Kim's persistence — 같은 구조의 병렬.

questions.passage: These stories show us the importance of having role models. Whether it is Cousteau's curiosity, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence, each of them demonstrates qualities that can inspire us. Their commitment and optimism teach us that career exploration is a journey, not a destination. Role models remind us that with hard work and __________, we can achieve our goals.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 적절한 단어를 원문에서 **영어**로 찾아 쓰시오.

조건: '헌신, 전념'이라는 뜻의 명사 1개

det.korean: 근면과 헌신(dedication)으로 우리는 목표를 달성할 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ dedication: 헌신, 전념. hard work and dedication(근면과 헌신)이 병렬 구조.
det.tip: dedication = devotion = commitment: 헌신, 전념. dedicate(동사) → dedication(명사).
